vulnerability_details.title: Cleartext HTTP Traffic Allowed
vulnerability_details.description: The application allows cleartext HTTP traffic (android:usesCleartextTraffic=true) to all domains. This exposes network communication to sniffing and MitM tampering.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Disable cleartext traffic in the Android Manifest and enforce HTTPS by configuring a Network Security Config file.

vulnerability_details.title: Exported Content Providers
vulnerability_details.description: One or more database Content Providers are marked exported without requiring any permissions.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Set android:exported="false" in AndroidManifest.xml or require custom permissions for accessing the content provider.

vulnerability_details.title: Hardcoded Cryptographic Secret Key
vulnerability_details.description: A hardcoded AES symmetric encryption key was discovered in class com.banking.security.CryptoManager.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Do not hardcode cryptographic keys in code. Use the Android Keystore system to securely generate and store cryptographic keys.

vulnerability_details.title: Biometric Bypass Vulnerability
vulnerability_details.description: Biometric prompt validation is implemented using client-side callbacks without crypto object verification.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Pass a cryptographic key initialized with BiometricPrompt.CryptoObject to authenticate and decrypt data.

vulnerability_details.title: Insecure Clipboard Usage
vulnerability_details.description: Sensitive credentials and session tokens are copied to the system clipboard without setting them as sensitive content.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Avoid copying sensitive data to the clipboard. If necessary, use ClipDescription.EXTRA_IS_SENSITIVE to hide clipboard content.

vulnerability_details.title: Weak Hashing Function (SHA-1)
vulnerability_details.description: The app uses SHA-1 algorithm for verifying local database cache signatures. SHA-1 is vulnerable to collision attacks.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Upgrade SHA-1 usage to SHA-256 or SHA-3 for secure signing and integrity verification.

vulnerability_details.title: Obfuscation Disabled
vulnerability_details.description: Proguard/R8 code shrinking and obfuscation is disabled.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Enable minifyEnabled true in build.gradle to obfuscate class and method names during release compilation.

vulnerability_details.title: Writable SD Card Storage Used
vulnerability_details.description: The application writes transaction logs to external public directories. Any application with read permissions can access these logs.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Store application-specific transaction logs in internal private storage directories.

vulnerability_details.title: Debug Log Leakage
vulnerability_details.description: The application contains active Log.d/Log.i statements exposing SQL queries and user IDs to Android Logcat console logs.
vulnerability_details.remediation: Configure Proguard/R8 rules to automatically strip logging statements in release builds.
